title: Accounts Catch-Up and Backlog Write-Up
summary: Write up months or years of missing books, rebuild bank reconciliations and prepare unfiled returns and statements.
metaTitle: Accounts Catch-Up: Write Up Missing Books and Backlog
metaDescription: Behind on your books? We write up months or years of missing accounts, rebuild reconciliations and prepare overdue returns and statements for a fixed fee.
heroIntro: Months or years behind on your books? We write up the backlog, rebuild reconciliations and bring your records current and audit-ready.
overview: Falling behind on bookkeeping is common, especially in fast-growing businesses. The risk is not just untidy records: late returns, missing credits and unanswered notices pile up. We write up the backlog in a structured way, starting with what the authorities and lenders need first.
whatWeDo: Write up months or years of missing books.
Bring your records current and audit-ready.
whoFor: Businesses with overdue GST, VAT or corporate tax returns.
Companies that need statements for a lender, investor or tax authority.
Owners who have lost track after a change of accountant.
note: In the UAE and Saudi Arabia, backlog catch-up is often combined with a VAT health check, so exposure is quantified and corrections are prepared.

faqs.q: Can you prepare overdue returns too?
faqs.a: Yes. We prepare the books first, then the overdue returns and statements. Fees, interest and penalties payable to authorities are paid by you at actuals.

faqs.q: What if I have no bank statements for some months?
faqs.a: We work from what is available: portal downloads, bank requests and supplier statements. We flag what cannot be verified in the findings note.
